name: cursor-spending
description: Cursor usage in the status bar: Auto, API, on-demand cap, tooltip with projections and billing context.

cursorSpending.sessionToken.description: WorkosCursorSessionToken cookie value from cursor.com. Get it from DevTools > Application > Cookies when logged into cursor.com/dashboard.

cursorSpending.billingCycleDay.description: Day of month your billing cycle resets (1-31). Used as a fallback if the API does not return billing period dates. Set to 0 to rely on the API value only.

enumDescriptions: Project usage across all calendar days in the billing period
cursorSpending.projectionMode.description: Controls how the straight-line usage projection counts days in the billing period

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:icon && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run build:icon && npm run compile && npx vsce package
